name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native architect workflow with primary-only simple lanes, worker-preferred commit/push, native Luna V2 engineering delegation, and explicit compatibility lanes.

interface.shortDescription: Default routing with primary-only simple lanes, worker-preferred commit/push, and native Luna V2 engineering delegation.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor routes every new request by default while keeping simple, status-only, install-only, and no-subagent work primary-only. Authorized commit/push prefers a compact native worker route that reuses the implementation worker when available, reducing primary-context token use while preserving exact scope and non-force push. Other engineering work that benefits from delegation uses native V2 roles through gpt-5.6-luna at max effort; the primary owns architecture and acceptance. App-task Luna and legacy Terra/Sol remain explicit compatibility options.
defaultPrompt: Route through Sol Advisor; prefer a scoped worker for authorized commit/push and native Luna V2 engineering.
Use app-task Luna or legacy Terra/Sol only when I explicitly authorize compatibility.
